test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SOLVE' is coded as 'QRJYC' and FENCE' is coded as 'DHLFC. How will 'TASTE' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

According to english alphabet series 

The pattern followed here is :

'SOLVE' is coded as 'QRJYC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dba970991ed2c7899bf612ea14053f9269062414e8f5b0c6e48c37736783aecc.png] 

Similarly,

 FENCE' is coded as 'DHLFC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3ef9e1407f7a7c7c98d49f1dbbaed9937b756d1c2b0db06f7f4735d9b3eee5a.png] 

**'TASTE' is coded as 'RDQWC'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3340d730db0357634d2185c28e650b079cafd9e730236a9662b58ca03e82c75.png] 

Hence, the **correct answer** is **"Option 2"**
